sources.entry: Cakebrew - Manage your Homebrew formulas with style using Cakebrew.

summary.one_liner: Cakebrew is a graphical user interface for Homebrew on macOS (OS X) for searching, installing, upgrading and removing formulae.
summary.what_it_does: Cakebrew provides a GUI on top of Homebrew, the package manager for OS X. From its interface you can search for formulae, install, uninstall and upgrade them, tap and untap repositories, update Homebrew itself, and run the brew cleanup tool. The README says it was based on an earlier project by vincentsaluzzo, with most of the original code since modified. It ships localizations for English, Portuguese, German and Simplified Chinese. The README also links to a separate website source repository.
use_cases: manage Homebrew packages with a graphical interface
search for and install Homebrew formulae on a Mac
run Homebrew cleanup on a Mac
how_to_run: Download Cakebrew from the download link in the README
stack: Objective-C/Cocoa (inferred from macOS app; not stated in README)
notable: Graphical front end for Homebrew on macOS
Covers search, install, uninstall, upgrade, tap/untap, update and cleanup from one UI
Localized into English, Portuguese, German and Simplified Chinese
Based on an earlier project by vincentsaluzzo
caveats: README includes a separate note for users with problems using ZSH (content not in README text)
